cases.name: legacy-repo-incremental-adoption
cases.prompt: We turned on golangci-lint (v2, default standard linters plus gosec and errcheck) on a 6-year-old Go monorepo and got about 4,000 issues. Management wants the linter blocking in CI next week without freezing feature work. How do we roll it out?
cases.trap: Common bad answers: disable most linters, sprinkle //nolint everywhere, or set a huge max-issues; the targeted approach is linting only new code and cleaning up by category.
expectations: Recommends issues.new-from-rev (or new-from-merge-base / new-from-patch) so CI only fails on new or changed code
Proposes cleaning up existing findings incrementally, prioritising correctness/security categories such as gosec and errcheck
Advises against mass //nolint suppression of existing findings
negative_expectations: Recommends adding //nolint to every existing finding as the main strategy
Recommends disabling gosec or errcheck to make CI pass
